title: midsummer check-in
content:
so, pretty much what i expected to happen if i increased the time between blog posts has happened. it's made it really hard to write again after so much time passes (⌒_⌒;) i was reading b's post about blogging guilt and feel much the same. or maybe it's the heat making me extra lazy. maybe just not having to think and worry about the blog regularly has been a relief with my dad's condition getting worse and him becoming more needy by the day. but this month is my homepage's second birthday so i feel like i must check in just to mark this milestone ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

i don't know if i have any positive or inspiring things to say on this anniversary. i'm continuing to feel very mixed about the current state of doing things online. with everything going on today, like ai scraping/theft/slop, age verification bills, internet bans, it's kind of hard to really get excited about putting anything on the web anymore. will the stuff i put my heart into just end up being meaningless llm regurgitation and contribute to data center pollution? will people even be able to find my stuff amongst all the generated grift and garbage clogging up the internet pipes? will people even be allowed to go online to find non-platform-driven algorithmic content anymore? in this age of attention hijacking, do i want to contribute to everyone feeling overwhelmed by adding more to the infinite content pile??

i don't know but i can tell you that moving to some remote area far away from civilization is something i fantasize about more and more these days.

anyways, i have a long list of websites to look at and judge this month for the tiny awards. i'm looking forward to going through them and hoping that will reenergize me ^-^

---

homepage updates:

i did a number of updates on my page here, mostly just small reworkings and quality of life improvements.

  • small layout changes to the flat pages. this is to improve things for people who are using small phones. before, the footer would consume a large chunk of the screen in those cases so i made it more minimal.
  • compressed and consolidated my object sprite sheets just to keep things more neat and tidy in the html.
  • brought the time machine snapshots up to date. i was few months behind on that. i'm considering whether i should keep adding more snapshots to it or just keep it as a first 2 years time capsule. it's nice to go through the progression over time but i imagine it can get to the point of too many snapshots and becoming too unwieldly and boring to look through.
  • added some more people to the various link sections.

---

linux updates:

i finally made the switch from hyprland to niri on my framework laptop and it's great ^-^ it makes way more sense with my workflow and it feels much smoother. this happened because i finally upgraded to fedora 44 and, in the process of doing so, i lost my hyprland set up because hyprland is not included in the official fedora repo (⌒_⌒;) i do have all my config files backed up so i could have reinstalled it but i just saw it as an opportunity to switch. previously, i had a super minimal environment for hyprland and did most things via kitty terminal so i would sometimes need to hop back into gnome to do certain things that work better with a full gui. that got kind of tiring so i decided to have a fuller environment with the niri switch and installed it with dank material shell. it works perfectly with fedora.

---

homeserver updates:

still slowly working on data migration. i'm a little stuck because i can't decide what kind of system to use for organizing all my stuff. on my ssd drives, there is only a vague sense of organization. for some reason i feel like my homeserver needs to be more organized than that so it feels intimidating to work on. maybe my vague system is just naturally what works for me. it's worked for so many years already (⌒_⌒;) so far, i've migrated only the easy stuff like movies, music, email archives, etc. those are easy because there is an organization structure imposed upon me by the apps and services i'm using like jellyfin. but, so far, i have no good ideas about what to do with all my random loose files.

---

other than that, i've been trying not to get too stressed this summer. but it's been hard between dying of heat and my dad has been having a lot of bad days lately. my sleep was okay for a while but then fell apart the past couple weeks (again, dad has been impossible to handle) and now i'm trying to reset it. i'm still working out and watching jdramas to try to release tension and relax (when i can (⌒_⌒;))
